en: A black-and-white postcard view of a formal garden leading up to a large, symmetrical manor house or small palace with a central tower-like roof feature. The foreground shows geometrically arranged lawns and paths with clipped hedges, and there are smaller outbuildings on each side. In the bottom left corner, the caption reads "Årsta, Österhaninge." In the bottom right corner there is a printer/photographer credit and logo.
